aboutSubheading: Keeping Chelsea homes and businesses pest-free for over 15 years
aboutText: Chelsea Pest Control has been proudly serving the Chelsea community and surrounding Bayside suburbs for over 15 years. Our fully licensed and insured technicians use the latest eco-friendly treatments to eliminate pests quickly and safely. Whether it's a residential call-out or a large commercial contract, we deliver reliable results every single time.

servicesSubheading: Comprehensive pest control solutions for every situation
servicesText: From routine inspections to emergency call-outs, Chelsea Pest Control offers a full range of pest management services tailored to your needs. We handle everything from ants and spiders to termites and rodents, using safe and effective treatments that protect your family and pets.

services.title: Residential Pest Control
services.desc: Complete home pest protection using safe, family-friendly treatments for ants, spiders, cockroaches, and all common household pests.

services.title: Commercial Pest Control
services.desc: Tailored pest management programs for offices, restaurants, warehouses, and retail spaces across Chelsea and the Bayside area.

services.title: Same-Day Pest Control
services.desc: Need help today? Our rapid response team can be at your Chelsea property within hours of your call — no waiting around.

services.title: Emergency Pest Control
